description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git fast-export' and 'git fast-import' functionality, including handling of various edge cases such as encoding re-encoding, tag filtering, path filtering, signed tags, signed commits, submodules, and more. It contains numerous test cases using 'test_expect_success' to verify different aspects of the Git export/import process.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success; runs the given commands and reports pass/fail.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the command and expects it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for exact match.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file, expecting it to be found.

methods.name: test_grep -E
methods.description: Extended regex search for pattern in a file.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock for testing timestamp-related features.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a config variable for testing.

methods.name: test_git
methods.description: Runs a git command in the test environment.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Returns the object size or object ID for testing.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that is allowed to fail without failing the test.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the output or file is empty.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
